privacy.singlePurpose: Fill supported developer-console listing fields from a prepared package and extract Chrome Web Store listing content into an editable package.
privacy.hostPermission: Content scripts run only on https://chrome.google.com/webstore/devconsole/* and https://partner.microsoft.com/*/dashboard/microsoftedge/* to read and fill the developer’s own listing form. The Chrome main-world script reads console responses for user-requested extraction. Broad browsing access is not requested.

testInstructions.instructions: See github.com/Vadagon/cwsagent#install. In a separate Chrome publishing profile with --apps-gallery-url, load the unpacked extension. Open your item’s Store listing, load a prepared ZIP/folder and choose Autofill. Inspect the filled fields; save manually. On Edge, open the item in Partner Center and use Autofill. Optional ExtensionTower Sync requires an account key and a package for that listing.
